summary: Logitech International S.A. filed a Form 8-K reporting the results of its Annual General Meeting held September 8, 2026, covering routine Swiss statutory items including approval of FY2026 annual report and financial statements (99.32% for), advisory votes on executive and statutory compensation and non-financial matters, appropriation of earnings and dividend declaration (99.32% for), amendments to the Articles of Incorporation regarding registered office and mandate limits, release of the Board and Executive Officers from liability (98.54% for), and re-election of incumbent directors. No special-situation transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or structural mechanic is disclosed. This is an ordinary AGM results filing under Item 5.07 with no deal terms or risk-arb angle.
